headline: Moody's: 'Semiconductor Boom to Last Until Mid-Next Year'... Raises Korea's Growth Forecast to 3.5%
summary: Moody's raised its 2025 growth forecast for South Korea to 3.5%, up from 2.5% in May and 1.8% in February. It expects the semiconductor boom to last until at least mid-next year.
why: Moody's is one of the three major credit rating agencies, and its growth outlooks inform views on sovereign credit and the economy.
